title: Fosters Needed
intro: These pups need a foster home, and some of them can't wait. Tap a dog's button to email us and raise your hand.

dogs.name: Haymitch
tags: Must be fostered with another dog
dogs.bio: An adorable, silly boy who loves playing, snuggling, and learning tricks! He's crate trained and doing great with potty and leash training. He thrives with structure, playtime, and puppy naps! 💤 Must be fostered with another dog.

dogs.name: Suits
dogs.bio: Suits is an adorable, energetic, affectionate puppy who loves cuddles, kisses, playtime, and being close to his people. He’s a happy, curious little Velcro dog who sleeps through the night, is learning basic commands, and needs a patient foster to help guide him through puppyhood and teething!

dogs.name: Commander
dogs.bio: Commander is a tiny, energetic dog who loves his toys, playing, and snuggling under a blanket with his favorite person. He is still learning potty training, leash skills, and crate comfort!

dogs.name: Ampert
dogs.bio: Ampert is a goofy, affectionate boy who loves long walks, other dogs, bones, and cuddling on the couch for hours. He is potty trained, walks beautifully on leash, does well home alone!
